parameters.query:
-- Mensagem enviada pelo WhatsApp do escritório que NÃO foi a IA: alguém da equipe respondeu.
-- A IA fica pausada nesta conversa. Comando "#ia" reativa a IA na hora.
WITH e AS (SELECT id, horas_pausa_ia FROM escritorios WHERE instancia_whatsapp = $1 AND ativo),
l AS (SELECT l.id FROM leads l JOIN e ON e.id = l.escritorio_id WHERE l.whatsapp = $2),
nova AS (SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mensagens WHERE wa_message_id = NULLIF($3, '')) AS ok),
cmd AS (SELECT lower(trim($4)) IN ('#ia', '#bot', '#ia on') AS reativar),
upd AS (
  UPDATE leads SET
    ia_pausada_ate = CASE WHEN (SELECT reativar FROM cmd) THEN NULL
                          ELSE now() + make_interval(hours => (SELECT horas_pausa_ia FROM e)) END,
    atualizado_em = now()
  WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM l) AND (SELECT ok FROM nova)
  RETURNING id)
INSERT INTO mensagens (lead_id, papel, conteudo, wa_message_id)
SELECT id, CASE WHEN (SELECT reativar FROM cmd) THEN 'sistema' ELSE 'humano' END, $4, NULLIF($3, '') FROM upd
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING lead_id;

-- Cria/atualiza o contato e guarda a mensagem. Mensagem repetida (webhook duplicado) não gera linha.
WITH e AS (SELECT id FROM escritorios WHERE instancia_whatsapp = $1 AND ativo),
l AS (
  INSERT INTO leads (escritorio_id, whatsapp, nome_whatsapp, ultima_msg_cliente_em)
  SELECT e.id, $2, NULLIF($3, ''), now() FROM e
  ON CONFLICT (escritorio_id, whatsapp) DO UPDATE
    SET nome_whatsapp = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.nome_whatsapp, leads.nome_whatsapp),
        ultima_msg_cliente_em = now(), atualizado_em = now()
  RETURNING id),
m AS (
  INSERT INTO mensagens (lead_id, papel, conteudo, tipo, wa_message_id)
  SELECT l.id, 'cliente', $4, $5, NULLIF($6, '') FROM l
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, lead_id)
SELECT id AS mensagem_id, lead_id FROM m;

parameters.query:
-- Só a execução da ÚLTIMA mensagem do cliente segue; ela junta todas as mensagens ainda não respondidas.
WITH alvo AS (SELECT $1::bigint AS msg_id, $2::uuid AS lead_id),
ultima AS (SELECT max(id) AS id FROM mensagens WHERE lead_id = (SELECT lead_id FROM alvo) AND papel = 'cliente'),
pend AS (
  UPDATE mensagens SET respondida = true
  WHERE lead_id = (SELECT lead_id FROM alvo) AND papel = 'cliente' AND NOT respondida
    AND (SELECT msg_id FROM alvo) = (SELECT id FROM ultima)
  RETURNING id, conteudo)
SELECT
  (SELECT msg_id FROM alvo) = (SELECT id FROM ultima) AS eh_ultima,
  (SELECT string_agg(conteudo, E'\n' ORDER BY id) FROM pend) AS texto_cliente,
  (l.ia_pausada_ate IS NOT NULL AND l.ia_pausada_ate > now()) AS ia_pausada,
  to_jsonb(l) AS lead,
  to_jsonb(e) AS escritorio,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('pergunta', f.pergunta, 'resposta', f.resposta))
            FROM faq f WHERE f.escritorio_id = e.id AND f.ativo), '[]') AS faq,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('nome', r.nome, 'cargo', r.cargo, 'areas', r.areas) ORDER BY r.nome)
            FROM responsaveis r WHERE r.escritorio_id = e.id AND r.ativo AND r.faz_reunioes), '[]') AS equipe,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', a.id, 'inicio', a.inicio, 'modalidade', a.modalidade,
                                                'status', a.status, 'responsavel', r.nome, 'link', a.link_reuniao) ORDER BY a.inicio)
            FROM agendamentos a LEFT JOIN responsaveis r ON r.id = a.responsavel_id
            WHERE a.lead_id = l.id AND a.status IN ('marcado', 'confirmado') AND a.inicio > now()), '[]') AS agendamentos,
  (SELECT r.nome FROM responsaveis r WHERE r.id = l.responsavel_id) AS responsavel_nome,
  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mensagens WHERE lead_id = l.id AND papel IN ('assistente', 'humano')) AS primeira_conversa
FROM leads l JOIN escritorios e ON e.id = l.escritorio_id
WHERE l.id = (SELECT lead_id FROM alvo);

  INSERT INTO mensagens (lead_id, papel, conteudo, wa_message_id)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, 'assistente', $2, NULLIF($3, ''))
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING lead_id)
UPDATE leads SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'novo' THEN 'em_triagem' ELSE status END, atualizado_em = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id;
